Job Posting Title:

10157986 
 Job Description:
 Department Description 
 At Disney, we’re storytellers. We make the impossible possible. The Walt Disney Company is a world-class entertainment and technological leader. Walt’s passion was to continuously envision new ways to move audiences around the world—a passion that remains our touchstone in an enterprise that stretches from theme parks, resorts and a cruise line to sports, news, movies and a variety of other businesses. Uniting each endeavor is a commitment to creating and delivering unforgettable experiences — and we’re constantly looking for new ways to enhance these exciting experiences.
 
 Team Description: 
 Disney Parks, Experiences and Products is seeking a Software Engineer with a passion for building world-class products and enabling our businesses to be future ready. We are looking for an engineer who has full stack programming experience and is enthusiastic to build and maintain new applications, improving our Guest and Cast experiences.
 
 What You'll Do: 
 Implement reliable, high-throughput, low latency, scalable and well-documented code to tackle sophisticated algorithms

 Collaborate with engineers, product owners, and other partners to propose extensible, reusable and performant solutions

 Experiment, develop proof of concept with relevant new technologies

 Able to work independently to analyze and solve issues as an individual contributor

 Troubleshoot, fix problems reported in lower and production environments

 Write unit and component tests to ensure delivery of high-quality code

 Monitor and proactively improve production run quality of applications

 Work in a scrum team and provide your daily updates

 
 Required Qualifications & Skills: 
 A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience

 Domain knowledge in multiple technical and business areas

 A minimum of 3 years of software engineering, analysis and design with full software development lifecycle experience. 

 3+ years of Java, Spring Framework, SQL (AroraDB) and NoSQL-based databases (MongoDB), writing complex SQL queries and building highly scalable and highly performant distributed applications and web services experience. 

 Exposure to GraphQL / Graph DBs

 A minimum of 3 years Internet technologies, microservices architectures experience.

 A minimum of 3 year of developing cloud native applications, preferably in AWS experience

 Experience with Docker / Kubernetes.

 Knowledge of CI/CD tools

 Knowledge of Splunk SPLs, App Dynamics, OTEL, Grafana Monitoring Tools

 Demonstrated strong analytical skills.

 Strong understanding of object-oriented programming with an understanding of design principles

 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience in the commerce space and products / pricing / inventory domains

 
 Required Education: 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science or similar field or related equivalent experience

 
 #DISNEYTECH
 
The hiring range for this position in Orlando, FL is $111,900 - $150,000 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.
